query:
SELECT 'marketplaceListings' as tbl, COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='reserved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as reserved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sold,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactive
FROM marketplaceListings
UNION ALL
SELECT 'marketplaceOrders', COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='pending_payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='shipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM marketplaceOrders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sellerProfiles', COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='suspended' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM sellerProfiles
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cartItems', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM cartItems
UNION ALL
SELECT 'offers', COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM offers;
